title: Get Deals Request
description: Request parameters for retrieving deal status and details. Supports filtering by deal IDs, buyer references, status, and platform.

account.description: Account to retrieve deals for. When omitted, returns data across all accessible accounts.

deal_ids.description: Array of protocol-level deal IDs to retrieve. When omitted along with buyer_refs, returns a paginated set of accessible deals matching status_filter.

buyer_refs.description: Array of buyer reference IDs to retrieve

status_filter.description: Filter by status. Can be a single status or array of statuses. Defaults to ['active'] only when deal_ids and buyer_refs are both omitted.

platform_id.description: Filter to deals on a specific SSP platform
